title: Audit Artist workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Artist area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: artist identity, private and public profiles, EPKs, dashboards, and artist workflows

in: docs/engineering/agents/artist/ — charter, state, architecture, backlog, interfaces, decisions, verification, working set
The artist default paths declared in WORKING_SET.json
docs/engineering/generated/ — routes, api-routes, components, database-schema, permissions, integrations maps
docs/work-packets/ — existing bounded work packets for this area
.agents/ legacy specialist ledgers that document this area
out: Production code and migration changes (this is a read-only audit)
docs/admin-audit remediation stream unless findings directly affect this domain
Agent registry, task model, and opencode agent definitions

acceptance_criteria: Baseline produced as docs/engineering/agents/artist/BASELINE.md: what the artist area contains today (routes, components, services, API routes, database objects, tests, evidence), each claim backed by a real path reference; plus the area's intended direction, cited to docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md, docs/work-packets/, docs/engineering/agents/artist/BACKLOG.md, and relevant specs.
Started from the domain working set and a packet built via npm run agents:context -- --task ARTIST-001; expanded scope only on evidence, with the path and reason recorded in a checkpoint.

Used deep research and sequential thinking to identify everything that is missing, incomplete, or needs improvement; recorded as docs/engineering/agents/artist/GAPS.md, every item triaged (missing / incomplete / improve) with evidence and location.

Produced docs/engineering/agents/artist/QUESTIONS.md: a prioritized list of questions to the product owner explaining how to build or fix each gap (build vs fix vs drop and sequencing); the questions are also surfaced in the final checkpoint summary.
Updated docs/engineering/agents/artist/STATE.md (working / partial / broken / focus) and BACKLOG.md to reflect the baseline findings.
No production code or migration files changed; this is a read-only audit task (qa/release additionally honor their edit: deny permission).
npm run agents:validate passes with 0 errors before completion.
The task is not blocked on unanswered questions; owner answers become follow-up task records owned by this agent.

evidence: BASELINE.md produced with 67 routes, 56+ API routes, 18 EPK components, 9 public artist components, 20 library files, 22+ database tables, 9 test files

STATE.md updated with durable facts, cross-domain dependencies, and known risks
BACKLOG.md updated with 16 candidate work items ordered by priority
No production code or migration files changed
